turns.question: How many delivery-topic customer service calls were there per 100 shipped orders in September 2026?
turns.answer: In September 2026 there was 1 delivery-topic call (calls labelled by a model, counted on the day of the call, 1-30 September) and 50 shipped orders (orders placed 1-30 September, status shipped); the semantic layer has no calls-per-100-orders metric, so I cannot give the per-100 rate from its figures.
